papers.note: S1665 comprehensive extraction update from scanned full text on 2026-07-08. Population layout updated to Total / Senior / Under 23 / Under 20. Table V extracted for HSI counts, match/training split, exposure hours, and HSI incidence per 1000 player-hours: Total 15 HSI, 9 match, 6 training, 24147.5 total h, 1072.5 match h, 23075 training h, incidence 0.62 / 8.39 / 0.26; Senior 15 HSI, 9 match, 6 training, 8170.5 total h, 511.5 match h, 7659 training h, incidence 1.83 / 17.59 / 0.78; U23 and U20 reported zero HSI with exposure rows. Table II used for sample and age rows. Results text used for all HSI non-contact, severity distribution, and note that no HSI occurred in U23/U20. The Table V all-injury counts were checked (Total 86, Senior 69, U23 11, U20 6) but the headline injury fields are kept HSI-specific because the reported incidence columns are HSI incidence.
